canal nx indisponível: abra este comando dentro de um worker Nexus

cause: The Codex runner environment does not define NEXUS_SHIM_ROOT, NEXUS_SHIM_CAPABILITY_ID, or NEXUS_SHIM_SECRET, so the local shim cannot submit to Nexus mail/send from this process.

sanitizedIncident.summary: A process-environment inspection command printed runner environment variables to tool output while looking for Nexus shim context.
sanitizedIncident.recommendedAction: Rotate credentials that were present in this runner environment before treating the transcript as clean.
